name: Kingdom of Italy

flag.description: Three equal vertical stripes of green, white and red, with the arms of the House of Savoy, a white cross on a red shield edged in blue, in the centre of the white stripe.
flag.symbolism: The green, white and red are Italy's national colours; the shield is the arms of the House of Savoy, the dynasty that unified Italy, edged in Savoy blue.

hook: The Kingdom of Italy's tricolour has the Savoy shield, a white cross on red, in the middle; the Republic dropped it in 1946, and Mexico's green-white-red carries an eagle instead.
trivia: The Savoy shield was removed after the referendum of 2 June 1946, in which Italians voted to abolish the monarchy.
The plain shield was the civil flag; state and military versions placed a royal crown above it.
